name: Weekly GitHub Dev Summary — Claude + Slack/Discord

nodes.name: Build Weekly Run Config
nodes.notes: Configurable variables: GITHUB_REPO, LANGUAGE, DELIVERY_MODE, DESTINATION_CHANNEL.

nodes.name: Dry Run Enabled?
nodes.notes: Set DRY_RUN=true for a no-secret validation execution using sample data.

nodes.name: Fetch GitHub Activity
nodes.notes: Uses GitHub GraphQL API to fetch commits, recently closed issues, and merged PRs.

nodes.name: Claude API — Narrative Summary
nodes.notes: Calls claude-sonnet-4-20250514 as required by the bounty.

parameters.jsCode:
const data = $('Generate Dry Run Sample Data').first().json;
const summary = data.language === 'FR'
  ? `## Highlights
- ${data.commits.length} commits, ${data.closed_issues.length} tickets fermés et ${data.merged_prs.length} PRs fusionnées cette semaine.
- Le travail s'est concentré sur l'authentification, les états de chargement et la documentation de déploiement.

## Risques / Blocages
- Aucun blocage critique détecté dans l'échantillon de validation.

## Prochaines étapes
- Vérifier le prochain cycle de déploiement et surveiller les webhooks.`
  : `## Highlights
- ${data.commits.length} commits, ${data.closed_issues.length} issues closed, and ${data.merged_prs.length} PRs merged this week.
- Work focused on authentication hardening, dashboard polish, and deployment documentation.

## Risks / Blockers
- No critical blockers were detected in the validation sample.

## Next Steps
- Verify the next deployment cycle and monitor webhook delivery.`;
return [{ json: { ...data, summary, generated_by: 'dry-run' } }];

nodes.name: Format Slack/Discord Payload
nodes.notes: Builds Slack or Discord payload based on DELIVERY_MODE and DESTINATION_CHANNEL.

parameters.jsCode:
const data = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { status: 'ok', mode: 'dry-run', title: data.title, body: data.body, payload: data.payload } }];
